what: Plan routes validator failures through exit $? in scripts whose callers parse structured stdout
scenario_or_breakage: Invalid disallowed tmpdir exits 2 without PUBLISH_OK or PAUSE_OK, breaking /design publish and pause parser contracts
suggested_fix: Use script-local failure paths: design-log-publish should emit_publish_result false and exit 0; design-pause-save should emit_fail "tmpdir-invalid" or equivalent after validation

what: Plan inserts allowlist validation before existing absolute-path validation and exits with validator status
scenario_or_breakage: Relative --design-tmpdir now reports parent resolution or allowlist failure and exits 2, breaking the invalid-argv contract and existing harness expectation
suggested_fix: Place larch_design_tmpdir_validate after the absolute-path check and map failure to exit 1 for this script

what: Plan validates immediately after argv presence, before variant-specific empty or missing tmpdir handling
scenario_or_breakage: --design-tmpdir '' --variant step3 now exits 2 instead of printing the existing warning and exiting 0; test-emit-design-plan-preview.sh case for empty tmpdir fails
suggested_fix: Move validation inside step3 and gatec after the existing -z or ! -d friendly branch and before any plan.txt read or marker touch
